_doc: MCP route coverage ledger (#1470). One row per authenticated route that no tool calls by its route function. 'tool:<name>' an existing switched-on tool covers it another way; 'retired:<name>' that tool is switched off by default; 'out:<reason>' it gets no tool, on purpose; 'deferred:<slice>' a tool is still to be built (PLAN in docs/mcp-server.md, 'Route coverage ledger'). A route a tool starts calling leaves this file in the same change; tests/python/mcp/test_mcp_route_coverage.py enforces it.
